cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen opens with header, filter-mode/range entry fields, column headers and key legend
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Operator is signed on and selects Customer Inquiry from the Main Menu, starting transaction ORQC.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Customer Inquiry screen (transaction ORQC)
2. Read the whole screen without typing anything
cases.expected: The screen is drawn fresh (erased): the header shows Tran `ORQC`, Pgm `OCCUSIN`, the title `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM` and the current date and time. The mode prompt `Mode (I=ID F=FICO S=State/ZIP):` and the entry fields `Cust ID From:` / `To:`, `FICO From:` / `To:`, `State:`, `ZIP:` are shown. The column headers `Cust ID`, `Name`, `ST`, `ZIP`, `FICO` are shown, the 13 list lines are blank, and the message line shows `Choose filter mode I/F/S, key args, press ENTER.`
cases.remark: UI §2.1 / §4 · map MCUSINA mapset MCUSIN · 1000-SEND-INITIAL (SEND ERASE) · msg WS-M-PROMPT

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: A populated result page maps each matched customer to the five list columns
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (5 customers). Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I` (customer-id range), leave the From/To bounds blank
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the list rows
cases.expected: Each matched customer occupies one list line showing the five columns: Cust ID (e.g. `000000001`), Name (`JOHN SMITH`, assembled as first name + last name), ST (`NY`), ZIP (`10001`) and FICO (`720`). The five F-STD customers are listed in customer-id order 000000001..000000005.
cases.remark: 4200-PLACE-ROW maps KUR-ID/KUR-NAME/KUR-STATE/KUR-ZIP/KUR-FICO → CUL/CUN/CST/CZP/CFI; name from OUCUSIN 2600-BUILD-NAME (first + last, middle dropped)

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the filter mode defaults to ID-range and the cursor sits on the mode field
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Customer Inquiry screen (transaction ORQC)
2. Check the pre-filled mode value, the message line and the cursor position
cases.expected: The mode field is pre-filled with `I` (id-range filter is the default), the message line shows `Choose filter mode I/F/S, key args, press ENTER.`, all range/state/zip fields and the 13 list lines are empty, and the cursor is positioned on the mode field ready for entry.
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL: MOVE 'I' TO FMODEO; SET KUI-F-IDRANGE TO TRUE; MOVE WS-M-PROMPT TO ERRMSGO; MOVE -1 TO FMODEL (cursor)

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Entry fields are enterable on the key prompt while result and header fields are display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. On the initial (key-prompt) screen, try to place the cursor in each field
2. Apply a filter and, on the result screen, try to type over a listed row
cases.expected: On the key prompt the seven entry fields (mode, Cust ID From/To, FICO From/To, State, ZIP) accept input; the header fields (Tran, Pgm, title, date, time), the column headers and the 13 result lines are protected (display-only) and cannot be typed into. After a filter runs the result rows remain display-only.
cases.remark: MCUSINA item-states §2.1: FMODE/FRID/TOID/FRFICO/TOFICO/FSTATE/FZIP UNPROT; header + CUL*/CUN*/CST*/CZP*/CFI* ASKIP

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Mode I lists customers whose id falls in the keyed range
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (customers 000000001..000000005).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`
2. Enter Cust ID From = `000000002`, To = `000000004`
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Exactly the three customers whose id is between 000000002 and 000000004 inclusive are listed: `000000002` MARIA GARCIA (CA), `000000003` ROBERT JOHNSON (IL), `000000004` LINDA WILLIAMS (FL). The summary line reports `3 match` with the FICO min/avg/max of that set.
cases.remark: OUCUSIN 2400-FILTER-CHECK KUI-F-IDRANGE: CU-ID >= KUI-ID-FROM AND <= KUI-ID-TO; STARTBR at KUI-ID-FROM · replaces batch OBCUSTP

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Mode F lists customers whose FICO score falls in the keyed band
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (FICO scores 720, 680, 640, 750, 700).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `F`
2. Enter FICO From = `700`, To = `999`
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The three customers whose FICO is 700 or higher are listed in id order: `000000001` JOHN SMITH (720), `000000004` LINDA WILLIAMS (750), `000000005` DAVID BROWN (700). The summary line reports `3 match, FICO min/avg/max 700/723/750  End of list.`
cases.remark: OUCUSIN 2400 KUI-F-FICO: CU-FICO-SCORE between KUI-FICO-FROM/TO · avg = (720+750+700)/3 = 723 ROUNDED (3000-FINALIZE) · replaces OBRSCORE

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Mode S with a state and no ZIP lists every customer in that state
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `S`
2. Enter State = `CA`, leave ZIP blank
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The one customer in California is listed: `000000002` MARIA GARCIA, ST `CA`, ZIP `94105`, FICO 680. The summary line reports `1 match` with that customer's FICO as the min/avg/max.
cases.remark: OUCUSIN 2450-CHECK-STATE-ZIP: CU-ADDR-STATE = KUI-STATE; blank ZIP (WS-ZIPLEN=0) → state-only match · replaces OBRZIP

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Mode I with both bounds blank lists the whole customer file
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (5 customers).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`
2. Leave Cust ID From and To blank
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: All five customers are listed in id order (000000001..000000005). With the bounds blank the range defaults to 000000000..999999999, so every customer matches. The summary line reports `5 match, FICO min/avg/max 640/698/750  End of list.`
cases.remark: 5100-PARSE-IDRANGE defaults: MOVE ZEROS TO KUI-ID-FROM, MOVE 999999999 TO KUI-ID-TO when field blank · avg (720+680+640+750+700)/5 = 698

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Mode S with a ZIP prefix narrows the state match to matching ZIP codes
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (New York customer has ZIP 10001).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `S`
2. Enter State = `NY`, ZIP = `100`
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Only the New York customer whose ZIP begins with `100` is listed: `000000001` JOHN SMITH, ZIP `10001`. The ZIP is matched on its keyed leading characters (a prefix), not the full value; the summary line reports `1 match`.
cases.remark: 2450-CHECK-STATE-ZIP: WS-ZIPLEN = position of last non-space in KUI-ZIP; CU-ADDR-ZIP(1:WS-ZIPLEN) = KUI-ZIP(1:WS-ZIPLEN)

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: The summary line reports the match count and FICO min/avg/max of the whole matched set
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (5 customers, FICO 720/680/640/750/700).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`, leave the bounds blank (match all)
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the summary/message line
cases.expected: The summary line reads `5 match, FICO min/avg/max 640/698/750  End of list.` — the count is zero-suppressed, and the FICO figures are the minimum (640), the rounded average (698 = 3490/5) and the maximum (750) taken over the whole matched set. The `End of list.` suffix shows there is no further page. The counts are filter-wide totals, computed by scanning the whole file even though only one page is shown.
cases.remark: 4300-BUILD-SUMMARY (WS-CNT-ED ZZZZZZZ9, WS-FICO-*-ED ZZ9); OUCUSIN 3000-FINALIZE avg ROUNDED; whole-file scan each call

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: ENTER re-applies a changed filter so the operator can refine the key and inquire again
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. A first inquiry (mode `I`, all) has already been run and its page is shown.
cases.steps:
1. Change the mode field to `F` and enter FICO From = `640`, To = `680`
2. Press ENTER again
3. Read the new list
cases.expected: The previous result is replaced by the new filter's result: the two customers with FICO between 640 and 680, in id order — `000000002` MARIA GARCIA (680) and `000000003` ROBERT JOHNSON (640). Pressing ENTER always re-reads the current filter arguments and lists the first page for them.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHENTER → 2100-APPLY-FILTER re-parses the map each turn; KUI-START-KEY reset to ZEROS

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open (with or without a result shown).
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3
cases.expected: The Customer Inquiry screen is abandoned and control passes to the Main Menu program; the inquiry does no file access on the way out.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU: EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM('OCMENU') COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA)

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: PF7 restarts the current filter at the first page
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. A filter (mode `I`, all) has been run and its page is shown.
cases.steps:
1. Press PF7
2. Read the list
cases.expected: The same filter is listed again from the top: the first page of the current filter is redisplayed (customers 000000001..000000005) with the paging cursor reset to the start of the file. The filter arguments are unchanged.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF7 → 2300-RESTART: MOVE CA-WORK-AREA TO KUI-REQUEST; MOVE ZEROS TO KUI-START-KEY; re-LINK OUCUSIN

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: PF8 pages forward to the next page of a multi-page result
cases.precondition: F-PAGE loaded (20 customers, ids 000000001..000000020, all matched by mode `I` all). A first inquiry has been run: page 1 shows the first 13 customers and the summary line ends `PF8=more PF7=top`.
cases.steps:
1. Press PF8
2. Read the second page
cases.expected: The next page is shown: customers 000000014..000000020 (the remaining 7 rows). Paging resumes from the key saved on the previous turn, so no customer is repeated or skipped; because this is the last page the summary line now ends `End of list.`
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF8 → 2200-PAGE-NEXT: KUI-START-KEY = KUI-NEXT-KEY from prior page; OUCUSIN captures matches with CU-ID > KUI-START-KEY up to WS-MAX-ROWS(13)

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Re-running the same filter returns the same customers and aggregates (read-only)
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Run mode `S`, State = `CA` and note the listed rows and the summary line
2. Press PF7 to restart the same filter
3. Compare the two results
cases.expected: Both runs return the identical result — the same customer(s) and the same match count and FICO min/avg/max — and no customer master row is created, updated or deleted. The inquiry is read-only and repeatable.
cases.remark: OUCUSIN browses only (STARTBR/READNEXT/ENDBR); UI §5 no C/U/D; whole-file scan is deterministic

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: ENTER hands the filter to the customer browse engine and shows the returned page
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open. The customer browse engine sub-program is available in the CICS region.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`, leave the bounds blank
2. Press ENTER
3. Confirm the listed page came back from the browse engine
cases.expected: The screen calls the customer browse engine (a sub-program) passing the chosen filter and a top-of-file start key, and paints the page of customers, the resume key and the match/FICO aggregates it returns — the screen itself performs no file access. The five F-STD customers and their aggregates are shown.
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB: EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('OUCUSIN') COMMAREA(KCUSIN-AREA); engine reads CUSTFILE (VSAM KSDS)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: An unsupported filter mode is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Type mode = `X` (not one of I/F/S)
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the message line
cases.expected: No browse is performed and the message line shows the verbatim string `Mode must be I (id) F (fico) or S (state/zip).` The cursor returns to the mode field so the operator can retype `I`, `F` or `S`.
cases.remark: 5000-PARSE-FILTER EVALUATE WS-MODE WHEN OTHER → WS-M-BAD-MODE; SET WS-INVALID; MOVE -1 TO FMODEL. Literal on-screen string, no EI/EF code (see NOTES audit dismissal)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: A non-numeric customer-id argument is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`
2. Enter Cust ID From = `12A45` (contains a letter)
3. Press ENTER
4. Read the message line
cases.expected: The id argument fails the numeric check and the message line shows the verbatim string `Numeric filter argument is not valid.` No browse is performed; the operator can re-key a numeric id. A blank id field is accepted (it means the range default), but a field containing any non-digit character is rejected.
cases.remark: 5100-PARSE-IDRANGE → 6000-PARSE-NUM: non-space/non-digit char SET WS-INVALID → WS-M-BAD-NUM (trigger point: id-range field). Literal string, no EI/EF code

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: A non-numeric FICO argument is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `F`
2. Enter FICO From = `7X0` (contains a letter)
3. Press ENTER
4. Read the message line
cases.expected: The FICO argument fails the numeric check and the message line shows the verbatim string `Numeric filter argument is not valid.` No browse is performed. This is the same message as the bad customer-id case but raised at a different entry step — the FICO band field.
cases.remark: 5200-PARSE-FICO → 6000-PARSE-NUM (trigger point: FICO field, distinct from id-range) → WS-M-BAD-NUM. Split per distinct trigger point (derivation §Density)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Mode S with a blank state is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `S`
2. Leave State blank while keying a ZIP
3. Press ENTER
4. Read the message line
cases.expected: The message line shows the verbatim string `State is required for the state/zip filter.` No browse is performed; state is mandatory for the state/zip filter even when a ZIP is keyed.
cases.remark: 5300-PARSE-STZIP: IF KUI-STATE = SPACES → WS-M-STATE-REQ; SET WS-INVALID. Literal string, no EI/EF code

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported attention key is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Customer Inquiry screen open.
cases.steps:
1. Press an unsupported key, e.g. PF5
2. Read the message line
cases.expected: A fresh screen is shown and the message line shows the verbatim string `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.` Only ENTER, PF7, PF8 and PF3 are honoured.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN OTHER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL + WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (WMSG). Literal string, no EI/EF code

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A filter that matches no customer reports an empty result
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (customer ids 000000001..000000005).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`
2. Enter Cust ID From = `000000100`, To = `000000200`
3. Press ENTER
4. Read the message line
cases.expected: No customer id falls in 100..200, so no row is listed and the message line shows the verbatim string `No customers match the filter.` The list area stays blank.
cases.remark: 4000-SHOW-PAGE: IF KUI-ROW-COUNT = ZEROS → WS-M-NONE-FOUND. Literal string, no EI/EF code

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: PF8 past the last page reports end of list
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. A filter (mode `I`, all → 5 customers on a single page) has been run.
cases.steps:
1. Press PF8 when there is no further page
2. Read the message line
cases.expected: There is no further page, so the message line shows the verbatim string `End of list - no more customers.` and the current page is left in place.
cases.remark: 2200-PAGE-NEXT: after the last page KUI-ROW-COUNT = 0 on the next call → WS-M-END-LIST. Literal string, no EI/EF code

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A failure to reach the browse engine is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. The customer browse engine sub-program is unavailable / not installed in the CICS region (fault injection).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`, leave the bounds blank
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the message line
cases.data: Mode = `I`; browse engine LINK forced to fail *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: The link to the browse engine fails, so no page is shown and the message line shows the verbatim string `Unable to link to browse engine OUCUSIN.`
cases.remark: 3000-CALL-SUB: IF WS-RESP-CD NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL) → SET KUI-ERROR, MOVE WS-M-LINK-ERR TO CA-ERR-MSG; shown by 4000-SHOW-PAGE. Literal string, no EI/EF code

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: List columns render the full field widths of a customer row
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Run mode `I`, all
2. Inspect one full row against the column widths
cases.expected: Each column shows its full width: Cust ID up to 9 digits (`000000001`), Name up to 30 characters (`JOHN SMITH`), ST 2 characters (`NY`), ZIP up to 10 characters (`10001`) and FICO 3 digits (`720`). A name longer than the Name column is truncated to 30 characters.
cases.remark: KCUSIN row: KUR-ID 9(09), KUR-NAME X(30), KUR-STATE X(02), KUR-ZIP X(10), KUR-FICO 9(03); map CUL/CUN/CST/CZP/CFI

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Customer-id range bounds are inclusive; an inverted range returns nothing
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (customer ids 000000001..000000005).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`, From = `000000003`, To = `000000003`, press ENTER (single-id lookup)
2. Then enter From = `000000004`, To = `000000003` (To below From), press ENTER
cases.expected: Case A: exactly customer `000000003` ROBERT JOHNSON is listed — both bounds are inclusive, so From = To returns that single id. Case B: with To below From no id can satisfy the range, so no row is listed and `No customers match the filter.` is shown.
cases.remark: 2400 idrange CU-ID >= FROM AND <= TO (inclusive); 2250-HANDLE-RECORD CU-ID > KUI-ID-TO → END-OF-FILE (inverted range yields 0 rows)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Customer-id bounds accept the full nine-digit width
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `I`, From = `000000000`, To = `999999999`
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The bounds are accepted at their extreme values — the minimum 000000000 and the maximum 999999999 that the nine-position id field can hold — and every customer on the file is listed (5 rows), the same result as leaving the bounds blank.
cases.remark: FRID/TOID field width 9; KUI-ID-FROM/TO PIC 9(09) max 999999999; the blank-field default in 5100 fills the same range

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: FICO band bounds are inclusive at both ends
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `F`, From = `680`, To = `720`, press ENTER and note the matches
2. Then enter From = `681`, To = `720`, press ENTER
cases.data: Case A From = `680`, To = `720`; Case B From = `681`, To = `720`
cases.expected: Case A: the customers with FICO 680, 700 and 720 are listed in id order (`000000001` JOHN SMITH 720, `000000002` MARIA GARCIA 680, `000000005` DAVID BROWN 700) — both band ends are inclusive. Case B: raising the low bound to 681 drops the 680 customer, leaving 700 and 720 (2 rows). The boundary value 680 is included at 680 and excluded at 681.
cases.remark: 2400 fico CU-FICO-SCORE >= KUI-FICO-FROM AND <= KUI-FICO-TO (inclusive both ends)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: FICO bounds accept the full three-digit width
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded.
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `F`, From = `000`, To = `999`
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The FICO bounds are accepted at the extremes the three-position field can hold (minimum 000, maximum 999) and every customer matches (5 rows). Although real FICO scores run 300..850, the field itself permits 000..999.
cases.remark: FRFICO/TOFICO field width 3; KUI-FICO-FROM/TO PIC 9(03) max 999; the blank-field default in 5200 fills 0..999

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: ZIP is matched on its keyed prefix length only
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded (New York customer has ZIP 10001).
cases.steps:
1. Enter mode `S`, State = `NY`, ZIP = `1` (one character), press ENTER
2. Then ZIP = `99999`, press ENTER
cases.data: Case A State = `NY`, ZIP = `1`; Case B State = `NY`, ZIP = `99999`
cases.expected: Case A: the one-character prefix `1` matches ZIP `10001`, so `000000001` JOHN SMITH is listed — only the keyed leading characters are compared. Case B: the prefix `99999` does not match `10001`, so no row is listed and `No customers match the filter.` is shown.
cases.remark: 2450-CHECK-STATE-ZIP: WS-ZIPLEN = last non-space position; compares CU-ADDR-ZIP(1:WS-ZIPLEN) = KUI-ZIP(1:WS-ZIPLEN); blank ZIP → whole state

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Exactly 13 matches fill one page; a 14th spills to a second page
cases.precondition: F-PAGE loaded. Two variants: (A) trimmed to exactly 13 matching customers; (B) 14 matching customers.
cases.steps:
1. Variant A: run mode `I`, all (13 customers), read the page and press PF8
2. Variant B: run mode `I`, all (14 customers), read the page and press PF8
cases.data: Variant A = 13 matches; Variant B = 14 matches
cases.expected: Variant A: all 13 rows are filled (the maximum a page holds); the summary line ends `End of list.` and pressing PF8 shows `End of list - no more customers.` (no empty second page). Variant B: the first 13 rows are shown, the summary line ends `PF8=more PF7=top`, and pressing PF8 shows the 14th customer on a second page.
cases.remark: OUCUSIN WS-MAX-ROWS = 13; a 14th match sets KUI-MORE (2250-HANDLE-RECORD ELSE branch). F-PAGE constructed — the shipped CUSTFILE seed has only 5 rows
